title: SaaS Lab
purpose: Build one end-to-end workspace invitation flow.
scope: Model membership, invitation and server-side authorization.
Use two synthetic tenants to test access boundaries.
non_goals: No real billing, email delivery, customer data or production deployment.
constraints: Discover the existing stack before choosing a new one.
A client-supplied tenant id does not authorize access.
acceptance: An unauthorized tenant cannot read or accept another tenant invitation.
The UI and API handle expired and repeated invitations.
